verses.text: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
lines: God, don’t keep silent.
Don’t keep silent,
and don’t be still, God.

verses.text: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
lines: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up.
Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

verses.text: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
lines: They conspire with cunning against your people.
They plot against your cherished ones.

verses.text: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
lines: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation,
that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

verses.text: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
lines: For they have conspired together with one mind.
They form an alliance against you.

verses.text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
lines: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites;
Moab, and the Hagrites;

verses.text: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
lines: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek;
Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.text: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot.
lines: Assyria also is joined with them.
They have helped the children of Lot.

verses.text: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
lines: Do to them as you did to Midian,
as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

verses.text: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
lines: who perished at Endor,
who became as dung for the earth.

verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
lines: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb,
yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

verses.text: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
lines: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

verses.text: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
lines: My God, make them like tumbleweed,
like chaff before the wind.

verses.text: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
lines: As the fire that burns the forest,
as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

verses.text: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
lines: so pursue them with your tempest,
and terrify them with your storm.

verses.text: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
lines: Fill their faces with confusion,
that they may seek your name, Yahweh.

verses.text: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
lines: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever.
Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

verses.text: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
lines: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh,
are the Most High over all the earth.
